# arin_rdap_domain (Data Source)

Read a public reverse-domain registration from ARIN RDAP, including nameservers, published DNSSEC data and complete JSON. No API key is sent. Forward domains, referrals and partial responses are not supported. This reads registration data, not live DNS or DNSSEC validation results.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
data "arin_rdap_domain" "example" {
  name = "2.0.192.in-addr.arpa."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Reverse DNS domain in in-addr.arpa or ip6.arpa. Case and an optional trailing dot are normalized for lookup.

### Read-Only

- `delegation_signed` (Boolean) Published delegationSigned flag indicating DS records in the parent. Null if omitted.
- `ds_records` (Attributes List) ds records returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ds_records))
- `events` (Attributes List) events returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `handle` (String) handle returned by ARIN.
- `key_records` (Attributes List) key records returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--key_records))
- `max_sig_life` (Number) Published maximum signature lifetime in seconds. Null if omitted.
- `nameservers` (Attributes List) nameservers returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nameservers))
- `network_handle` (String) network handle returned by ARIN.
- `org_handles` (List of String) org handles returned by ARIN.
- `rdap_json` (String) Complete domain JSON, including embedded network/entity records, DNSSEC metadata, links and extensions. No links are followed.
- `status` (List of String) status returned by ARIN.
- `unicode_name` (String) unicode name returned by ARIN.
- `zone_signed` (Boolean) Published zoneSigned flag. Null if omitted; this provider does not validate DNS signatures.

<a id="nestedatt--ds_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ds_records`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (Number) algorithm returned by ARIN.
- `digest` (String) digest returned by ARIN.
- `digest_type` (Number) digest type returned by ARIN.
- `key_tag` (Number) key tag returned by ARIN.


<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) action returned by ARIN.
- `date` (String) date returned by ARIN.


<a id="nestedatt--key_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `key_records`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (Number) algorithm returned by ARIN.
- `flags` (Number) flags returned by ARIN.
- `protocol` (Number) protocol returned by ARIN.
- `public_key` (String) public key returned by ARIN.


<a id="nestedatt--nameservers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nameservers`

Read-Only:

- `ipv4_addresses` (List of String) ipv4 addresses returned by ARIN.
- `ipv6_addresses` (List of String) ipv6 addresses returned by ARIN.
- `name` (String) name returned by ARIN.
